Name: Avatar Snowboarding
Overview:
Hit the slopes with your avatar. Enjoy breathtaking 3D HDR scenery, awesome 3D physics, hundreds of millions of levels, and more!

Snowboard alone or with a friend split-screen style. You have but one goal - make it to the bottom of the mountain.

Oh, and don't worry about calling for a pick-up. You are equipped with an infinite rocket booster should you need a push. Use with caution!!
